questions.question: What is the relationship between OpenAPI and Swagger UI?
options: OpenAPI is the format that describes an API, and Swagger UI displays it as a web page
They are two names for the same file
questions.explanation: OpenAPI is the specification. Swagger UI reads an OpenAPI file and draws it as clickable documentation.

questions.question: Which library generates the OpenAPI file from Spring Boot controllers?
questions.explanation: springdoc-openapi scans the mapped endpoints at runtime and serves the OpenAPI JSON and Swagger UI.

questions.question: With springdoc and no custom properties, at which path is the raw OpenAPI JSON served?
questions.explanation: The default path of the OpenAPI JSON is /v3/api-docs.

questions.question: A controller method has @Hidden and is otherwise a normal @PostMapping. What happens to it?
options: It is removed from the documentation but still works when called
questions.explanation: @Hidden only hides the endpoint from the generated docs. The endpoint itself is unchanged.

questions.question: A team adds the springdoc starter to pom.xml without a version, and the build fails. What is the cause?
options: Spring Boot does not manage the springdoc version, so it must be written in the pom
The starter must be a test dependency
questions.explanation: The Spring Boot parent manages its own starters, not springdoc, so you must give the springdoc version yourself.
